map.基于ABC分类与出库频次，推荐货位区域分配方案。A类高频品靠近出入口，C类低频品: Based on ABC classification and outbound frequency, recommend slot zone allocations: high-frequency class A items near the door, low-frequency class C items far from it, improving overall picking efficiency.
map.ABC 分类：输入「品名,出库频次」逐行数据，按频次降序累计，累计占比≤70%: ABC classification: enter "name, outbound frequency" line by line, accumulate in descending frequency order, and classify a cumulative share of 70% or less as A, 90% or less as B, and the rest as C, returning the SKU count and frequency share per class.
map.货位分区：按 A/B/C 的 SKU 数量占比分摊排数——A 排数=round(: Slot zoning: allocate bays by the SKU-count share of A/B/C — A bays = round(total bays × A count ÷ total count), the same for C, and B takes the remainder with at least one bay. With the door at the front, the A zone takes bays 1 to aRows and the C zone the last cRows bays; with the door at the back the layout mirrors (the A zone sits by the rear door).
map.上架复核：结果为分区排号范围与各级频次，可直接转成上架表和复核清单；复核重点是大: Put-away review: the result gives zone bay ranges and per-class frequencies, which convert directly into a put-away sheet and review checklist. Focus the review on whether large-volume class A items really occupy a whole zone, and whether the frequency definition matches the ERP.
map.算例：8 个 SKU 的 ABC 分区（10 排、门在前端）: Worked example: ABC zoning of 8 SKUs (10 bays, door at the front)
map.：输入频次：1200、900、700、500、300、200、120、80，总出: : entering frequencies 1200, 900, 700, 500, 300, 200, 120, 80 with a total outbound frequency of 4000, the descending cumulative shares are 1200→30.0% (A), 900→52.5% (A), 700→70.0% (A), 500→82.5% (B), 300→90.0% (B), 200→95.0% (C), 120→98.0% (C), 80→100.0% (C). Class A has 3 items (2800 in total, 70.0%), class B 2 (800, 20.0%), class C 3 (400, 10.0%). Zoning: with 10 bays, A = round(10×3÷8) = 4, C = 4, and B = 10−4−4 = 2. With the door at the front, A takes bays 1–4, B bays 5–6, and C bays 7–10; with the door at the back, A takes bays 7–10 and C bays 1–4.
map.为什么按 SKU 数量而不是按频次分配排数？: Why Allocate Bays by SKU Count Rather Than Frequency?
map.工具按 SKU 个数占比分摊排数，可避免个别超高频单品把整个近门区占满、其他 A: The tool allocates bays by the share of SKU count, which stops a single ultra-high-frequency item from filling the whole near-door zone and forcing other class A items farther away. The cost is that bay count decouples from volume: if a class A item is very bulky and will not actually fit the bays it was assigned, adjust it by hand and record the adjusted bay and the reason in the input snapshot so the review stays traceable.
map.出库频次的数据口径怎么定，换周期会影响分类吗？: How Should Outbound Frequency Be Defined, and Does Changing the Period Affect Classification?
map.建议统一取同一统计周期（如近 90 天）的出库行数或拣货次数，不要混用订单数与件: Use a single consistent period (say the last 90 days) and either outbound line count or pick count; do not mix order counts with piece counts, since the different magnitudes change the cumulative share directly. Changing the period shifts the classification, so cross-period comparison must fix the period and data source and note the data range beside the result.
